A document is filed only when exactly one request accepts it - or, when one document names several forms as itself, when each of those forms is accepted by exactly one request, or, when a broker's consolidated statement is accepted by several requests, when exactly one of them accepts it for its 1099-B, which then holds the whole statement. Ambiguous, contested and unrecognized files go to 00 - Needs Review for a person - misfiling a tax document is worse than not filing it.
